name: WeChatPadPro
description: OpenClaw channel plugin for WeChat — thin client of the WeChatPadPro middleware

wechatpadpro.label: WeChatPadPro
wechatpadpro.description: Connect OpenClaw to WeChat via the standalone WeChatPadPro middleware. This plugin is a thin client: it subscribes to the middleware over WebSocket for inbound messages and POSTs outbound sends. The WeChat server connection (host, authcode, webhook) is configured on the middleware itself, not here.

bridgeUrl.description: WebSocket base URL of the WeChatPadPro middleware, e.g. ws://127.0.0.1:8077

bridgeToken.description: Bearer token shared with the middleware (must match the middleware's bridgeToken).

account.description: Middleware account id to subscribe as.

dmSecurity.description: DM security policy (enforced in this adapter before the agent runs).

allowFrom.description: List of wxid allowed to DM the bot (used when dmSecurity = allowlist).

groupAllowFrom.description: Group ids (…@chatroom) whose messages may reach the agent. Empty or absent = block all groups; "*" = allow all groups.

enabled.description: Whether this channel is enabled. Default true when the section is present.

accounts.description: Multiple WeChat accounts. Each key is an OpenClaw accountId (which is also the middleware subscribe account unless overridden by its own "account"). Per-account fields override the base section.

bridgeUrl.description: WebSocket base URL of the middleware (defaults to the base section's bridgeUrl).

bridgeToken.description: Bearer token (defaults to the base section's bridgeToken).

account.description: Middleware account id to subscribe as (defaults to this entry's key).

dmSecurity.description: DM security policy for this account.

bridgeUrl.label: Middleware URL
bridgeUrl.help: WebSocket base URL of the WeChatPadPro middleware process. The adapter connects here for inbound messages and derives the HTTP send endpoint from it.

bridgeToken.label: Bridge Token
bridgeToken.help: Shared bearer token; must equal the middleware's bridgeToken.

account.label: Account
account.help: Middleware account id to subscribe as (default "default").

allowFrom.label: DM Allowlist
allowFrom.help: wxids permitted to DM the bot (used when dmSecurity = allowlist)

groupAllowFrom.label: Group Allowlist
groupAllowFrom.help: Group ids (…@chatroom) the agent may listen to. Empty = no groups; "*" = all groups.
